title: Roommate W: Futari
overview:
Two hearts, each with its own feelings

In this romance simulation from the Roommate series, two young women move in with you: Yuko Yamaguchi, a high school senior from Sendai, and Kaori Sato, a nursing college student from Shizuoka. Move around your home, talk with either of them and pick your replies from a set of choices. Your answers decide how close you grow to each of them and can lead to special events.

The game runs on the Saturn's internal clock, so events unfold in real time and your home changes its look with the actual time of day.

- Two heroines sharing one roof
- Real-time events tied to the Saturn clock
- Two CD-ROMs

2つのハート、それぞれの想い
